name: Gubra A/S
summary: Gubra A/S is a biotechnology firm engaged in two core activities: offering contract research organization (CRO) services for pre-clinical development, and advancing its own internal early-stage drug and target discovery initiatives. Its CRO division provides specialized pre-clinical research and development support to companies in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors. These services encompass a wide range of capabilities, including in vivo pharmacology, tissue analysis, various assay development, molecular pharmacology, bioanalytical testing, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and both two-dimensional and three-dimensional imaging techniques. Established in 2008, the company has its headquarters in Horsholm, Denmark.
